glossary.scope: As used in sections 2151.82 to 2151.84 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Young adult" means a person eighteen years of age or older but under twenty-one years of age who was in the temporary or permanent custody of, or was provided care in a planned permanent living arrangement by, a public children services agency or private child placing agency on the date the person attained age eighteen.
